$comment: Manual edits on top of the generated trees (SPEC §4.4). `prune` removes a move and everything after it from one tree. Use it for lines from the low-level games that only demonstrate a mistake.

prune.line: d4 d5 Bf4 Nf6 Nc3 Nc6 Nb5 Bf5
prune.reason: ...Bf5 allows Nxc7+ forking king and rook; the series game continued Kd7 Nxa8. Not a line to drill.
